# gemini_push_for_toe — exploratory TOE-direction notes (Gemini, 2026-06-09)

**Status: exploratory, unverified.** These notes were generated by Google's Gemini exploring possible routes from the Zimmerman a₀ framework toward a theory of everything — conformal de Sitter/CFT, causal sets + Sorkin's Λ, a unified entropic action, a "dark dimension" + Standard-Model sector, the chirality wall, and emergent gauge symmetry. They are committed here **only for visibility of the direction Gemini tried**, not as established results.

They have **not** been audited to this project's standards. Several of the doors here (dS/CFT, causal sets / Sorkin's Λ, and the Standard-Model ↔ a₀ seam / chirality wall) overlap routes the project has already assessed and found to be **dead ends or category errors** for deriving the Standard Model from a₀ — see the genuine, verified verdicts in [`real_research/TOE_SEED_VERDICT_2026-06-06.md`](../real_research/TOE_SEED_VERDICT_2026-06-06.md), [`real_research/TOE_DOORS_REANALYSIS_2026-06-06.md`](../real_research/TOE_DOORS_REANALYSIS_2026-06-06.md), and [`RETRACTIONS.md`](../RETRACTIONS.md).

Treat this folder as a **record of an attempt to be checked**, not as a TOE.
